entities.summary: Hans Lipperhey, also known as Johann Lippershey or simply Lippershey, was a German-Dutch spectacle-maker. He is commonly associated with the invention of the telescope, because he was the first one who tried to obtain a patent for it. It is, however, unclear if he was the first one to build a telescope. Hans Lippershay was a architects & engineers from Wesel (1570, Wesel–1619-09-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
